answer: Every identity must re-prove liveness each epoch by finishing one fresh, randomly assigned micro-task within four hours — a real job, like untangling a nebula of stale docs or auditing a timber of log lines — while a sparrow of its output is checked by three peers. A 1,000 POA bond locks 45 days; missing the task or copying an answer freezes the identity and slashes 100%. A 200-clone farm must do 200 real jobs per epoch, $25 and three hours each. A 150-agent ring was caught when 132 of its patches were byte-identical and submitted within 90 seconds.
